visit_notes.note: S: Diabetes management visit. Patient reports eating out more frequently due to travel for work. States he has been checking glucose at home and values range 130-180 fasting. Took a planned vacation last week and intentionally ate more carbohydrates. Reports he increased his walk to 30 min daily since last visit. O: BP 134/84. Weight 98.0 kg. Fasting glucose 138. A: T2DM - suboptimal control but patient has been more active. Dietary indiscretion contributing. HbA1c 7.4 (up from 7.1 six months ago). P: Intensify dietary counseling. Continue current meds. RPM glucose monitoring - alert threshold set at >180 mg/dL fasting. Recheck HbA1c in 3 months.
